cause_quote: #194885 replaced the read-side checkpoint with `readLocalWorkspacePath(...)` and `readRoot = backing.root` under `if (params.worktreeId && params.root && !params.historical)` (no sandbox check), while saves still only ran `checkpointLocalWorkspacePath` before writing canonical files, so previews read the stale private checkout.
user_saw: After saving a file in the Control UI, the next preview showed the old content, and host-only sessions with a leftover sandbox checkout previewed stale guest bytes.
summary: Saves now write canonical files and import the change into the private sandbox checkout under the same settled custody, and private backing reads are limited to sandbox sessions.
reasoning: The fix PR names #194885 as the source, and its diff (read at 94d45c8d5144) switches file reads from checkpointing then reading canonical files to reading the live private backing for any worktree session, without syncing saves into that backing or gating on a sandbox. Before that commit reads checkpointed guest state and read canonical paths, so save-then-preview worked; the fix adds the `sandbox &&` guard and post-save projection sync.
